description: This file defines the DateRange class, an immutable class representing a range of dates, extending ComparableRange<Date>. It includes methods for creating date ranges, checking inclusion and intersection, and converting dates to timestamps.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: An immutable range of dates, backward compatible with older code that uses this specific class. Provides methods for date range operations such as inclusion, intersection, and duration.

methods.name: DateRange
methods.description: Constructor initializing the date range, defaulting to earliest and latest dates if null.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if the range is after a given date.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if the range is before a given date.

methods.name: durationInMillis
methods.description: Returns the duration of the range in milliseconds.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date.

methods.name: endStamp
methods.description: Returns the end date as a Timestamp.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if a date is within this range.

methods.name: intersectsRange
methods.description: Checks if a given start and end intersect with this range.

methods.name: intersectsRange
methods.description: Checks if another DateRange intersects with this range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date.

methods.name: startStamp
methods.description: Returns the start date as a Timestamp.
